LONG BEACH CONTINUUM OF CARE MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 2, 2024
  200 W. BROADWAY
  BILLIE JEAN KING LIBRARY, 1:00 PM

Kimberly Wee, Co-Chair  Luther Richert, Member
Jamies Shuford, Co-Chair  Melanie Martins, Member
Aiko Tan, Member  Nikki Amick, Member
Anna Topolewski, Member  Pam Chotiswatdi, Member
Brandon Washington, Member  Shelbby Bambrick, Member
Claude Diles III, Member  Tamika Boyce, Member
Daniel Brezenoff, Member  Zhena McCullom, Member
Hawk McFadzen, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER

Meeting called to order at 1:04 PM by Co-Chair Jamies Shufford.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Tan, Topolewski, Washington, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert,
Martins, Amick, Boyce, McCullom, Shuford, Wee, Lock

Commissioners Absent: Chotiswatdi, Bambrick

Also present: Jennifer Santana, Secretary, Alexa Dixson-Griggs, Community Program Specialist V.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55097  Recommendation to review and approve the 2024-2025 Continuum of Care New
  Projects Request for Proposals applications.

  • Member Zhena McCullom join the meeting at 1:10PM and Member Connor
  Lock join the meeting at 1:19PM.
  • City Staff Alexa Dixson-Griggs reviewed the 2024-2025 NOFO ranking, the
  panel reviewed the applications and made recommendations on Monday the
  16th. The team is currently working on getting the final ranking approved.
  • The NOFO application is due on October 30th, and it is a 2yr NOFO but 1yr
  contract with flexibility to make changes.
  • Members of the board have questions regarding the ranking breakdown. The
  scoring tool helps us expand the funds by understanding what are the things
  that are required within a contract and informing the agencies. The rating tool
  can be located online.
  • Encompass Housings is a new agency to the city and CoC, they will be
  operating out of Long Beach.

  Page 1 of 2
   LONG BEACH CONTINUUM OF CARE MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 2, 2024
  200 W. BROADWAY
  BILLIE JEAN KING LIBRARY, 1:00 PM

  • HUD has requested that we work on our portfolio, and our staff is currently
  working on this while reallocating funding. Agencies have already received
  notices about the reallocation, and some have requested to combine their
  consolidated amounts into a single project. Almost all projects fall under Tier
  1.
  • Staff and members of the board review the project priority listing and discuss
  Tier 1 and Tier 2 funding.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Washington, seconded by Member McFadzen,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  10 Washington, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Martins, Amick,
  McCullom, Shuford, Wee, Lock
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 6 Tan, Topolewski, Richert, Chotiswatdi, Bambrick, Boyce

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • CoC Board meeting next week on Tuesday, October 8th, 2024.
  • Member Melanie Martins shares information on the Veterans stand down fair for veterans
  experiencing homelessness at Veterans Park on Wednesday October 16th.

ADJOURNMENT

Co-Chair Jamies Shufford adjourned the meeting at 1:30 PM.

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
